reviews.title: Serious glitch
reviews.text: About 2 to 3 months ago, I started noticing that any of my recurring calendar events, when edited or changed, would pull up the original date I created the recurring event. In other words, for example, say I create a recurring event called “wash dogs” to reoccur every two weeks on a Tuesday and I created it on August 1. If I want to edit it today and put a checkmark emoji ✅ on it to note to myself that I did complete it, and I “save the change for this event only”, it will only save/add my ✅ edit/change the original creation date event of August 1. I reached out to Google via email with no response to this day. I have had to resort to using my Apple calendar for all edits to recurring events, and I’m literally working out of two calendars. Tedious and frustrating.

reviews.title: Wrong Address on Mobile
reviews.text: I have an appointment later today and they sent me a calendar invite which I added to my google calendar. On the web app, it shows the address just fine, but on mobile it has the street number but instead of the street name it says the name of the city followed by "downtown investor center" and when I open the link to google maps it's directing me to some place 13 miles away. Fortunately I already know roughly where this place is so I got online to double check the address, and that's when I realized that the address on the calendar entry on the web app has the full and correct address. This seems like a weird and serious bug. If I had trusted the address on the mobile app calendar entry, I would have missed the appointment and spent 45 minutes driving there and back for no reason.

reviews.title: Disappointed to say the least
reviews.text: I hate using this calendar it’s by far one of the worst calendar apps I’ve ever used. You would assume a calendar app is pretty simple and that it’s hard to go wrong with a calendar app yet Google somehow manages it. I hate that you can’t turn an event into a task and vice versa. I also hate that I can’t remove a calendar from my list if it’s been I was the owner of the shared calendar. I should be able to create a calendar and unsubscribe from it. Also there aren’t enough features for me to fully customize it to my needs. I just want to be able to make several variants of events and name them instead of having all event under a calendar just show up as an event with the title. I want to be able to use it for school so my lectures can be one type of event, and due dates be another type of event or to add tasks to an event ugh! The other calendar apps I have used are simple enough to understand yet can be taken further through customization and that’s what Google Calendar is missing.

Damit ist es unmöglich, zu einem zukünftigen Datum zu springen um zb einen Termin zu planen. Denn beim erstellen eines neuen Termins kann man nicht sehen ob und wann was frei ist bzw welche Termine kollidieren.
Bitte baut wieder einen Button zim Navigieren und Springen zu einem bestimmten Datum. Das ist eine Grundfunktion eines Kalenders.

reviews.title: No option to display the correct date as an icon?
reviews.text:
I’ve been a Google Calendar user for years, but recently the app icon on my iPhone has been stuck showing “31” every day instead of the current date. Today is June 2, yet the small app icon on my Home Screen still shows 31. The same incorrect icon even appears in the App Store.

I’ve updated the app, updated iOS, restarted my phone, reinstalled the app, and tried every troubleshooting step I could find, but the issue remains. Interestingly, if I switch to the large widget view, it displays the correct date, which suggests the problem is specifically with the small app icon.

One of the main benefits of a calendar app is being able to glance at the icon and immediately see today’s date. Having it permanently display 31 makes the feature unusable and frustrating. This appears to be either a bug or a design flaw that I’d appreciate the development team investigating and fixing.

reviews.title: Native Keep Reminders to Calendar Tasks kills functionality
reviews.text:
The legacy Widget allowed for way more visibility on all events over a three day plus period - surprised that the team would remove this in favor of the modern format that lists just 2 events.

The giant “+” button in the lower right is intrusive, and not necessary as I can add an event with a drag and drop on any day. Would be nice to have an option to disable this giant “+” button in settings.

Because Keep reminders are now Tasks and only fire through Google Calendar or Tasks, I have to remember to open the Calendar or Tasks app so it syncs over after every new reminder is created. Otherwise, notifications will never fire or update properly 

Because calendar notifications go away when the app is opened, it’s no longer a safe or stable system for reminders (if I don’t check notifications panel first or accidentally open the app, they get wiped out). 

It also fails to pull the most recent edits of the note once created as a task - so if I add a last minute item to the top of the list later, it’ll never update Tasks - even if I change the reminder time after it fires

If I don’t open this app for a while (since I really only use Keep, not Tasks) - newly created reminders in Keep just never fire notifications

reviews.title: Notifications not 100% reliable
reviews.text: Depending on your use case this may make this app more or less attractive. Personally I’d like it to reliably send notifications for my tasks but it doesn’t do that.

reviews.title: Verschlimmbessern ist überflüssig
reviews.text: Bisher habe ich den Googelkalender gern genutzt. Gerade die verschiedenen Farben haben es übersichtlich gemacht. Nun seit dem letzten Update kann man keine Farbe mehr auswählen und die bestehenden Termine haben ihre eigene Farbe verloren. Schade das hier irgendwelchen Inkompetenzen Programmierer nur um ein Update anzubieten den Kalender verunstalten. Da kann ich auch bei dem IPhone Kalender bleiben. Auf dem IPad hat sich im Übrigen trotz Update nichts geändert. Scheint also an der App zu liegen. Echt lächerlich.

reviews.title: 改善希望
reviews.text:
5年程利用していますが今一歩使いづらいです。無料アプリとしては充分なのかもしれませんが不足が補えれば最強です。不満なら有料アプリを使うべきかもしれませんが。
①色の選択肢を増やしてほしい
現状は原色のみで目への刺激が強く、色の種類も少ないため充分な色分けができない。
②サブタスクを追加してほしい（チェックボックス付の）
例えば『17:00-18:00買い物』なら、その中にサブタスクがあれば買い物リストを設定できて便利です。
例えば『10:00-11:00ミーティング』なら、その中にサブタスクがあれば持ち物や事前準備のためのタスク管理ができて便利です。

reviews.title: Gut aber seit Langem mit Bug
reviews.text: Hallo, jedes Mal, wenn man mit seinem iPhone einen Kalendereintrag erstellt, und dann einen Ort hinzufügen möchte, hängt sich die App auf, und man muss sie beenden und alles erneut ausfüllen, dann funktioniert es. Hängt jedes Mal bei dem Schritt. Neu Installieren bringt Nix, seit gestern habe ich sogar ein neues iPhone damit das selbe Problem.

reviews.title: 祝日が予定に埋もれて気づかないカレンダー
reviews.text:
月表示が致命的に使いづらいです。
祝日が「終日予定」扱いのため、予定を入れるだけで簡単に見えなくなります。
祝日や週末を背景色で区別することもできず、表示順の制御も不可。

祝日は予定ではなく、生活や仕事の前提条件です。
それが月表示で埋もれる設計は、「カレンダー」として欠陥レベルだと思います。

他社アプリや紙のカレンダーですら普通にできている
・祝日／週末の背景表示
・終日予定の表示優先度設定
が、なぜ何年も放置されているのか理解できません。

高機能な予定管理を語る前に、
暦としての最低限のUXを見直すべきです。

reviews.title: No more birthdays
reviews.text: Due to the fact that Google made birthdays (stored in the contact details) not available in the calendar anymore and the “work arounds” are rather complicated an user unfriendly, I had to switch to an alternative provider. Thank you for nothing.

reviews.title: Colours show wrong in the app
reviews.text: My calendar events are beautifully colour coordinated when I open in browser but within the app the colours look completely different. Also wish that for the day view you could choose where the day begins and ends — I’m not going to be scheduling anything at 3am.

reviews.title: One of the most limited calendar apps out there
reviews.text:
The limited functionality from a company like google is just staggering. many features that are available on web are unbelievably not on mobile. when i display a week, i must see a full 7 day week, and i cannot hide weekends (like you can on web). as a person who is forced to use this awful calendar app for work, i would literally never want to see a weekend. when i subscribe to calendars, they are stuck in an automatic order. on the list of calendars, you only see yours and tasks (two calendars i would never want to hide) and you have to click show more to get to the list of other calendars you subscribed to (still locked in alphabetical order), making it very difficult to see someone else’s calendar without several clicks. overall a very lacking calendar app i would never recommend. if you are looking to pick this for your company, please don’t. 

sincerely,
a captive user who hates his calendar app

reviews.title: Layout velho e ultrapassado
reviews.text: Está mais que na hora desse app inovar seu modo como apresenta as tarefas e atividades aos usuários. Porqu não inovar em um layout onde podemos separar as tarefas por ícones ou emojis daquelas diárias, pessoais e semanais? Apps igual o Tiimo são muito mais dinâmicos e ousados. Esse app precisa sair desse modo feio e sem graça para algo mais dinâmico pessoal.

reviews.title: Problème impossible à résoudre
reviews.text:
Impossible de créer des événements et de changer la récurrence.
J’appuie sur les zones heure et récurrence mais rien ne se passe.
D’habitude ça fonctionne très bien mais là y a rien à faire. On dirait que ça ne veux plus fonctionner, alors que je viens d’en faire un autre il y a 10 minutes.
Je ne comprends pas, je me sers de Google agenda depuis toujours et je n’ai jamais rencontré ce problème avant.
C’est très frustrant j’en ai absolument besoin rapidement.
Et pas moyen non plus de demander de l’aide ou de signaler le problème sur l’application car je ne peux pas joindre la bonne capture d’écran bref, je fais ce signalement dans les avis. C’est une bouteille à la mère que j’envoie….
Merci. Karine.
